# Ink & Memory

> Ink Memory is a multi-agent workbench for organizing personal thinking patterns.

## Summary

Ink Memory turns a real need into goals, tasks, visible multi-agent collaboration, and an inspectable tool topology. Skills provide methods, MCP connects context and capabilities, and Plugins package reusable combinations. Task history stays connected to the active goal. A validated goal structure, agent workflow, and module topology can be confirmed and saved as a reusable Deck.

## Product Boundaries

- Tasks, goals, agent roles, handoffs, tools, sources, and results remain visible.
- Skills, MCP, and Plugins are composed as an inspectable module topology.
- Task history continuously checks progress against the active goal.
- A Deck stores the validated path, not only the final output.
- Deck settlement requires user confirmation.
